scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-campusbuzz "vitest run tests/integration"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-campusbuzz "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:rules
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions

scripts.seed:exec: npm run build:tools && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-campusbuzz "node lib-tools/tools/seed.js"
